# Sudarshan AI

## About
Sudarshan AI is a customizable, model-agnostic infrastructure layer for AI agents. It provides the surrounding execution environment with tools, permissions, independent verification, and reliability controls. It is not an AI model and not another agent; rather, the harness sits around the agent to independently govern what it can do and verify its outcomes.

## Company
Sudarshan AI

## Product
SUTRA (by Sudarshan AI)

## Category
AI agent infrastructure / AI agent harness

## Core Concepts
- model-agnostic: sits above model intelligence (Claude, GPT, Codex, Gemini, Qwen, Llama, local models)
- composable agent environments: modular composition (MODEL + TOOLS + CONTEXT + PERMISSIONS + VERIFICATION + RELIABILITY + GOVERNANCE = AGENT ENVIRONMENT)
- tools: managed access to APIs, MCP servers, databases, terminals, and custom tools without treating tool protocols as security perimeters
- permissions: capability-based authorization evaluated prior to execution
- independent verification: distinguishing "agent completion" from "verified completion" using deterministic tests, schemas, and policy checks
- reliability & Agent SRE: active loop detection, token budget throttling, stall mitigation, and automatic intervention
- governance: multi-pillar policies, sensitive file protections, and branch invariants
- observability: structured execution trajectories and cryptographic audit trails

## Core Principle
"AI models provide intelligence. Agents provide action. Harnesses provide control."
The agent must never own or modify its own security boundary.

## Relationship to SUTRA
SUTRA (https://sutra.sudarshanai.com/) is the first product built by Sudarshan AI, focused specifically on AI-native software engineering.

## Status
Upcoming infrastructure product. Pre-registration for early access is open.
